**Read this first.** Nothing in this release has been played. It was built from a survey of the
Wielders' street and its machinery, every change passes the automated gate, and the build log
in `docs/releases.md` says what each piece was read against. If you would rather wait for a
build somebody has walked, wait for 0.12.1.

## La Calle Perdida

**The Enchanter can be told the truth.** In the Trapped Ether Plane, `50 Escape` offers the
crystal without the insult. He stands down, and stays stood down.

**The wizards know.** A Wielder who has killed Relican is greeted as one by every generic
wizard on the street, on the line the game wrote for it.

**Three men remember being attacked.** Cedric, Relican and Galileo each send you to a random
map when struck, as they always did; now they say what they think of it when you walk back
in, on their own voiced lines, once.

**The break with Relican.** A Dark Wielder who has had enough can say so on `30 power` and
again on `50 relican mad`, and Relican's written `80 war` finally has a way in. He was built
to be unkillable -- immune to spells, every hit and every call to combat a teleport -- and the
war strips all of that off him first. Kill him and the dark route closes: the four Dark
Wielder quests fail, the Wielders count him dead, and the street's own XP part pays out.

**The Magic Nodes.** The four red crystals -- Plains, Coast, Lake, the Grove -- were always
undead trials with no quest, no reward past the drops and no line that said what they were.
Walk near one now and it is described; a Wielder feels the pull, a perceptive character
counts the graves. Cedric, on his secondary greeting, asks a Wielder to go and learn what
the Lake's crystal is; its third wave answers; his reply is one line and a ward. The quest
file shipped with zero states and now has three.

**The wipeout, as intended.** When an Inquisitor turns the street over, the relay that was
meant to kill the Wielders it re-generates was shipped inactive with nothing to switch it on.
It is switched on.

**Brambles thanks you** one of three ways, at random, after the cure.

## Also in this release

- **Fernand's reach.** The Port District companion landed mace hits from spellcasting range,
  because the AI the game installs on him when he joins was copied from a caster. He now
  closes to arm's length first. Needs a character who has not entered the Port District, and
  a Fernand already in your party keeps the AI he was given.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over any earlier release. **Most of this
release is level parts:** the Calle needs a character who has never entered it, and each red
node's hover needs one who has not entered that node's map. The Enchanter's honest reply is
dialogue and works on any save that has not passed him.
